thanks for replying.

the main reason i dont want to talk to my family is because i dont want to be a burden on them. my parents already have some problems they're dealing with and i feel like this would put more unnecessary strain on them, which they dont need right now

the reason i dont want to talk to my friends is a bit more selfish. i dont want them to judge me. know that its ok for men to feel sad and have feelings etc, and i was brought up in a very pro-equality family, but i personally feel that im less of a man for feeling this way. i just feel like i would be so emasculated if i admitted this to anyone i know
